html_extension.requires: Provision Node>=22.12, npm dependencies, Chrome and optional ASR/rembg models for target OS/CPU during setup; run HTML preflight separately.

extract_rule: Extract selected independent ZIPs into the same toolkit root; preserve paths. Install core and presets first.
installation_mode: full-offline: download every pack during setup, install and persist into the skill directory before rendering
upgrade: Use current staging gemini_install.py with --upgrade and the previous installed manifest; changed distributed files are backed up; user edits are preserved.

validation.runtime_scope: Local Linux x86_64 Python/Node/FFmpeg; target Gemini account not accessed
